Creator: Archaeographic Commission (editor); letters of Kirill of Beloozero, Vasilii II, Metropolitan Jonah and others
Publisher: St Petersburg: v Tipografii Ekspeditsii zagotovleniia gosudarstvennykh bumag (title page)
Publication Date: 1841 (title page, OCR line 46)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1841); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: rus
Source: archive.org item aktyistoricheskiesobrannyeiizdannyearhe1, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (3,506,399) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1841, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the old Russian is in real Cyrillic and can be followed line by line, with steady errors (yat read as a soft or hard sign; some words garbled; document headings in small capitals are the worst). Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: State and church documents of 1334-1598, numbered. Kirill of Beloozero's letters to the princes: no. 12 (to Grand Prince Vasilii Dmitrievich) from about OCR line 2720; no. 16 (to Prince Andrei of Mozhaisk) from 3154; no. 27 (to Prince Georgii of Zvenigorod) from about 6486; his testament of 1427 from about 7243, where the OCR misreads the document number. On Isidore and the Council of Florence: the letter of Grand Prince Vasilii II to the patriarch of Constantinople, about 8370-8780; no. 41 (1448) from 9620; a letter of Metropolitan Jonah that names Isidore at about 10990-11000; Florence is named at about 12580 and 13070, among Jonah's letters and the bishops' sworn statements (about 12550-13700). The editors' notes begin at about 66469 and the contents list at about 67890.
